data.name: Nimr
data.gender_notes: Nimr is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-m-r', meaning 'lion' or 'tiger'. In Islamic tradition, Nimr is the name of a Prophet and a king mentioned in the Quran. He was a just and righteous ruler who upheld the truth and defended the weak against oppression. He is an inspiring figure of courage and strength. The name Nimr carries the meaning “Lion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nimr usually hope their child will grow to embody lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage, strength, and righteous rule.
data.etymology: Nimr belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nimr total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
